continuity: C-SHARP is the older brother and ARI is the younger brother. Both are stylized East Asian boys with fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. Exact face geometry is locked. System names remain C-SHARP and ARI; spoken Thai names are ซีชาร์ป and อาริ. Literal system names must not be used as visible text or visual prompt labels.

generationQA.faceIdentityLock: Keep exact eye shape, eyebrows, nose, cheek fullness, face width, skin tone, age, hair silhouette, outfit and relative height across scenes. Use Character Sheets plus previous scene image reference.
generationQA.visualPromptRoleNames: In imageDescription/videoPrompt use older brother and younger brother instead of literal C-SHARP/ARI wherever possible to reduce accidental text/nameplates.
generationQA.ariTtsAliasStrict: ARI is metadata only. Never send A-R-I as spoken text. Spoken name must always be อาริ (Ah-ree).
generationQA.csharpTtsAlias: Use ซีชาร์ป in spoken Thai dialogue.
generationQA.previousSceneReference: Use the immediately previous generated scene image as the primary continuity reference in PRO V6.8 when location/time/action continues. Preserve exact face, skin tone, outfit, props, height relationship, screen direction, obstacle state and lighting.
generationQA.cameraVariation: Avoid repeating the same camera move in consecutive scenes; vary wide reveal, medium, low side follow, over-shoulder, rear follow, three-quarter, gentle arc and static reaction shots.
generationQA.motionContinuity: No teleporting, duplicate characters, impossible platform positions or sudden obstacle resets.
